## Ruled · 2026-11-17T03:40Z

The maintainer, in the os-support-ai fleet project (thread "Run objectstack seat 3 console experience") at 2026-11-17T03:40Z, answered the seat's four-question pack (reviewed first by an independent fable agent at his request) with one word, verbatim: 「同意」 — i.e. every recommendation below.

Ruled: A — the AI assistant becomes one right-side drawer; maximize is in place and restores; the in-app bottom-right AI button is removed (one entry: the top-bar robot); old `/ai` and `/ai/build` links (shared links included) redirect to the opened drawer.
- Governing text this overrides: ui ADR-0057 §3 (「`/ai` = the same panel maximized」), Amendment A2 (「Maximize goes to `/ai/build?package=PKG`」), open question 2 (button stays, decided 2026-07-13) and open question 5 (「the routes are untouched」). The ADR is amended in a separate Tier H PR (docs only) before or alongside the code PR; the code PR cites it.
- Kept: ADR-0057 A1 — a new build starts UNBOUND (no empty app is created first). ADR-0063 stays compatible.
- #34610 builds on this drawer.
